newer_changes_search: Web search for 2025-2026 scholarship changes found nothing specific to the MoTA pre-matric ST scheme (no revised amounts, income limit, renaming or discontinuation). The MoTA page snapshot (2026-10-25) still states class IX-X, Rs 2.5 lakh income limit and Rs 225 / Rs 525 per month (the Dec 2019 revised rates, linked on the same page).

findings.note: Quote ('... disbursement of scholarship to eligible ST students ... through DBT') supports 'must be ST' only indirectly; context of the MoTA ST scholarship page makes it clear.
findings.suggestion: Quote the eligibility clause of the pre-matric ST guideline PDF (linked on the page) and raise rules to 'confirmed'.

findings.note: Cases cover 249,999 and 250,001 but not exactly 250,000 or a band straddling the limit, and no missing-field case (CONTENT_AUTHORING §6).
findings.suggestion: Add income 250000 (LIKELY_ELIGIBLE), band {200000-300000} (NEED_MORE_INFO, missing annual_income) and an empty-profile case.

findings.note: The MoTA page lists no documents; caste/income certificate, Aadhaar and bank account are plausible but not supported by the snapshot.
findings.suggestion: Cite the guideline PDF or an NSP document list.
